title: BurnNote temporarily stores only opaque ciphertext using zero-knowledge AES-256-GCM
content_md:
The safest sensitive data is data that is not stored. BurnNote temporarily retains only opaque ciphertext and uses zero-knowledge AES-256-GCM.

via Mastodon https://burnnote-vault.vercel.app/?utm_source=mastodon
